HERO.NAME: Jose Sojo
HERO.HEADLINE: Computer Engineer with 4+ years building and operating production systems — from code to infrastructure.

ABOUT.TITLE: Profile
ABOUT.P1: Senior Full-Stack Developer focused on backend, data integration and infrastructure automation. I design and ship production applications with TypeScript, Nuxt/Vue, Node.js, Go and PostgreSQL on Cloud environments.
ABOUT.P2: I come from the infrastructure side: I run Linux servers, orchestrate containers with Docker and Proxmox, and build CI/CD pipelines with GitLab and Jenkins. That lets me deliver complete systems, not just features.
ABOUT.P3: Today I lead the platform team at Sistemas Tecnológicos Alcaraván and teach Programming II at UNERG.

LEAD.B1: Leading the platform team: servers, VPS, monitoring and operational control.
LEAD.B2: Design and architecture of complex full-stack applications with TypeScript on Supabase / PostgreSQL (RLS, triggers, migrations).
LEAD.B3: CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Jenkins), Docker orchestration and deployments on Google Cloud Platform.

ANALYST.B1: Linux server administration (Ubuntu/Debian), resource monitoring and internal network management.
ANALYST.B2: Virtualization with Proxmox / KVM and Docker container orchestration.
ANALYST.B3: Observability with Grafana, Prometheus and node-exporter; automated database backups.
ANALYST.B4: Bash, Python and Go scripts to automate server and platform operations.
ANALYST.HIGHLIGHT: Impact: PBS (Proxmox Backup Server) rollout that cut backups from 8–12h down to 4–5h.

TEACHER.B1: Teaching Programming II in Computer Engineering: algorithms and software development.
TEACHER.B2: Academic project tutoring and section grading and records management.

SIBCI.B1: Local network (LAN/VLAN) management and support, switch administration and network services.
SIBCI.B2: Preventive and corrective hardware maintenance; Level 2 infrastructure incident resolution.

FREELANCE.B1: ERP/CRM systems and full-stack web solutions with Nuxt 3 / Vue 3, TypeScript, Supabase and PostgreSQL on GCP and AWS.
FREELANCE.B2: Docker containerization, infrastructure automation and data security with RLS policies.
FREELANCE.B3: Deployments on Nginx servers and GCP Cloud Run. Projects: Nutringest (SaaS) and Socius VE (ERP/CRM).
